_comment: Per-turn state tokens (cells S-full / S-gist, E4) build receipt, 24 Oct 2026: arch.state_tokens {k (default 4), mask turn_state | causal} on the llama family (fixed recursion included; MoR, MoE, attn_res, grpo and provenance_po refused), IR_SPEC_DRAFT.md section 1 at paperkiln 0a58e5b6. Numbers from tests/test_state_tokens.cpp and tests/test_state_tokens_ir.py on the laptop's CPU; CUDA compiled only (validation on Colab: tools/colab_cuda_validate.sh leg test_state_tokens).

cpp_test_state_tokens._note: k = 3, vocab 37, d 16, 2 heads; a three-turn conversation with two state blocks (26 ids).

python_test_state_tokens_ir._note: BPE vocabulary 400 (+ 4 state ids 400..403), d 32, 2 layers, 2 heads, T 128, 200 lm steps on synthetic multi-turn dialogues; 40 multi-turn prompts with state blocks, prompt 7 with a reply cut short (the template closes it).
chat_greedy_replies_identical_plain_kv_e: hello cara, nice to meet you.
a fish is a good friend.
i am not sure, thank you.

ember_gate._note: d 64, 2 layers, 2 heads, k 4, mask turn_state, 600 lm steps (final loss 0.2227); numpy vs mtstudio worst rel 2.39e-06 in every mode, greedy 40/40, eviction identical; manifest.json lists every file with its sha256.

readings_of_the_spec.complete_block: k consecutive ids vocab .. vocab + k - 1 in that order; a state id outside one is a state position of the current segment and completes nothing (training windows that start inside a block).
readings_of_the_spec.k_in_the_ir: the embedding's state_weight rows, equal to paperkiln.state_tokens.k (tools/ir_check.py checks both).
readings_of_the_spec.family_hint: llama_state for a plain llama with state tokens (either mask); llama_recursive keeps its hint under fixed recursion.
readings_of_the_spec.sft_trailing_block: a block that would end an SFT row is left out (no position reads it); a dialogue row past T + 1 after insertion is cut at its last whole exchange, a prompt/completion row is dropped, both counted in the state_tokens event.
readings_of_the_spec.loss: no loss where the target is a state id or the input is a state position.
readings_of_the_spec.raw_ids: state ids accepted only as a complete ordered block directly after an <|endoftext|> that closed an exchange; a missing block is not an error and is not inserted.
